001: Haoran, do you know that Mr. Li at the venue today?
Not yet, but I've heard he's very reputable in the industry.
Would you like me to introduce you?
That would be great, thank you for making the introduction.
Don't mention it, just follow me.
Okay, I was hoping to talk to him about a collaboration anyway.
002: Manager Wang, I'm glad to see you at the expo.
Same here, our phone conversation last time wasn't nearly enough.
Then why don't we find a place to sit down and talk in detail?
Good idea, I'm very interested in your company's new project.
We happen to have brought detailed materials with us.
That's great, let's talk over coffee then.
003: Mr. Chen, what did you think of this forum?
Overall it was good, just the speaking time was a bit tight.
Indeed, many guests didn't get a chance to have in-depth exchanges.
But the dinner the organizers arranged was quite thoughtful.
Then let's have a good chat at the dinner?
No problem, I'll come find you then.
004: Mr. Zhang, I heard your company has been expanding into overseas markets lately?
Yes, we're currently looking for suitable partners.
Our company has rich channel resources in Southeast Asia.
Really? Then we should definitely explore that further.
Here's my business card, shall we set up a time to talk in detail?
Sure, I'll have my assistant arrange the schedule.
005: Mr. Liu, what did you think of this morning's roundtable discussion?
I thought the discussion was lively, but the conclusions weren't clear enough.
Right, everyone is still figuring out the industry trends.
Still, hearing different companies' experiences was very valuable.
So how do you think we should follow up from here?
I suggest we first put together a consensus document, then schedule a time to talk in depth.
006: Mr. Zhao, do you attend many industry events like this?
Not that many, but I do come to the important expos.
Same here, I find face-to-face communication much more efficient than email.
Definitely, a lot of partnerships come out of conversations.
Then I'll let you know when there are good events in the future?
Sure, let's share information with each other.
007: Mr. Sun, what do you think of the industry report that was released this time?
The data is very thorough, but some of the forecasts I think are overly optimistic.
Which part are you referring to?
Mainly the forecast about next year's market growth rate.
So what do you think the actual situation will be like?
I expect it'll be more moderate, it won't grow that fast.
008: Mr. Zhou, I heard you have a good relationship with the industry association?
Pretty good, I often participate in the events they organize.
So do you think our company would be a good fit to join?
I think it would be a great fit, you'd get to know quite a few peers.
Not at all, I can introduce you if you'd like.
009: Mr. Wu, what are you mainly looking for at this expo?
We're looking to partner with some technology suppliers.
So are you familiar with our company's products?
I've seen your brochure before, it left a good impression.
Then let's set up a time, and I'll give you a detailed demo?
Sure, I happen to be free tomorrow morning.
010: Mr. Zheng, after all these years in the industry, do you have any insights to share?
I wouldn't call them insights, I just think integrity matters most.
Indeed, doing business is really about being a good person.
Right, reputation is worth more than anything.
Then I hope to learn from you going forward, Mr. Zheng.
You're too kind, let's learn from each other.
